author: Gaming_Jacker
quote:
Who could have predicted this? Well, if you've been paying attention to the landscape of the gaming industry for the past 10 years, it was obvious this was going to happen. And the 10/10 critic reviews (with multiple flaws pointed out) only validated our suspicions. Im going to keep this short:

 First of all less than 30 fps in 2026 is unnacceptable. GTA6 looks barely any better than RDR2, but somehow runs 4 times worse? Also there are a lot of ray tracing artifacts (boiling, shadow flickering, screen space artifacts) which ruin the immersion, so it doesnt even have that going for it.

 Secondly, the gameplay is an absolute chore to get through (literally). Somehow GTA6 has less gameplay in the first ~10 hours than Life is Strange, which is an interactive movie. The game doesnt even let you commit crimes whenever or wherever you want. A game literally called *GRAND THEFT AUTO* doesnt let you steal a car near your neighborhood because it would be mean to your neighbor. It is very clear that the GTA6 devs tried to copy RDR2 because it was successful, but they failed miserably because GTA is a sandbox, not an RPG. I want to be able to do whatever I want after the intro. Also the gunplay and the driving is painfully sluggish thanks to the 25 average fps this game runs at.

 Last, and probably most importantly, the story is boring and the characters are insufferable. There are no interesting or likeable characters, everyone is either boring or annoying. The two main MCs included. Lucia constantly acts entitled and ungrateful, and she mocks and demeans Jason who does everything to help her. He could literally fix all the problems in her life, and she's just gonna say "I could have done it better than you lol". And the worst part of it all is that Jason never stands up for himself. These two should have been the antagonists in the first chapter that the protagonist kills, and we never have to hear from them again, not the protagonists.

 So yeah all in all this is probably the worst entry in the series and one of the worst games I've ever played in general. It genuinely feels like it was made by people who either hate or don't understand why people play videogames.

author: Gaming_Jacker
quote: There is not really much that needs to be said. They just changed a bunch of things that didn't need to be changed and called it a "new game" so they had an excuse to remonetize Overwatch. You now need to grind the battle pass to unlock new heroes, and skins are locked behind $20 bundles. I'm not really surprised because eventually Activision ruins everything they own the rights to, but it's still extremely disappointing to see the original Overwatch get wiped from existence for this poor excuse of a "sequel".

author: Gaming_Jacker
quote:
I liked the original game, which is not surprising, many did, but while it had a good story and pacing, I was frustrated by the game's gameplay mechanics and flawed controls (this is the case with many console exclusives, but that doesn't make it any less of an issue). I was hoping they'd have fixed some of the flaws of the original game, but unfortunately they haven't touched gameplay at all, nor have they improved the controls. This "Remake" deserves nothing more than a 0 (unless your expectations are embarrassingly low) for 3 key reasons;
A) This is not a remake. It's borderline false advertising, and most likely intentional to justify the $70 price tag. The vast majority of the changes that were made are in no way "next-gen". They could have been included in the PS4, or even the PS3 version of the game in a free update.
B) Even if they called it what it is, a remaster, why do we need another remaster **** that has already been remastered? You can stick the PS4 disc of TLOU in a PS5 and you get the same experience with marginally inferior graphics.
C) I know I mentioned this before, but $70??? Seriously ND and Sony? What's the point of adding "audio description" for blind people if the majority of them WON'T BE ABLE TO AFFORD THE GAME? Especially during these times, it's absolutely disgusting for a AAA studio to pull a scam like this. Anyone who was involved in the decision making surrounding this project should be ashamed.
Besides, if you were gonna waste recourses to "remake a game from the ground up", why didn't you remake Uncharted or the Jak and Daxter franchise? Their mechanics are far more outdated and they would benefit much more from a modern remake with updated gameplay. Either they are lying about "remaking TLOU from the ground up", and it took them very little recourses to remake it, or these publishers/devs are completely tone deaf.
game_title: The Last of Us Part I

author: Gaming_Jacker
quote: Who are these people giving this game a 10? I don't own the game, I've only played the couple dozen times Activision has done free weekends (because clearly this game is doing great) and every 10 minutes I encounter a new game breaking bug. This wasn't a game made by professionals. This was a game made by attention seeking millennials on Twitter who are complete amateurs at game design. Seriously, instead of fixing the game, the developers are making fun and blocking the critics of the game. Don't waste your money on this abomination, buy Elden Ring or the new Shadow Warrior instead.
